hooks.command:
f=$(python -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path') or (d.get('tool_response') or {}).get('filePath') or '')" 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in *.py) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; d=$(dirname "$f"); i=0; while [ $i -lt 20 ] && [ ! -f "$d/tools/bp_offline_test.py" ]; do n=$(dirname "$d"); [ "$n" = "$d" ] && break; d=$n; i=$((i+1)); done; [ -f "$d/tools/bp_offline_test.py" ] || exit 0; out=$(cd "$d" && python tools/bp_offline_test.py 2>&1) || { printf 'bp_offline_test FAILED after editing %s

' "$f"; printf '%s
' "$out" | grep -E "FAILED|Error|assert|failed" | head -20; exit 2; }; exit 0
